description: This PHP source file contains utility functions related to call management in SuiteCRM. Specifically, it includes functions for generating dropdown options for call duration minutes and reminder times, with logic for default values, view-specific behavior, and localization.

methods.name: getDurationMinutesOptions
methods.description: Generates HTML for a dropdown of call duration minutes, setting default values and handling different views such as Edit, MassUpdate, and QuickCreate.

methods.name: getReminderTime
methods.description: Generates HTML for a dropdown of reminder times with localization, handling default values, and view-specific rendering. Deprecated in version 6.5.0.
